correspondences.notes: BIDS 1.11.2 has no tractography suffix or Zarr Vectors extension.

brainlife.desc: Zarr Vectors store of streamline geometry converted from a .trk, .tck or .trx tractogram with zarr-vectors-tools.
brainlife.name: neuro/track/zarr-vectors

original.desc: Zarr Vectors store containing streamline geometry ingested from a tractogram (.trk/.tck/.trx) via zarr-vectors-tools (zvtools). See https://zarr-vectors-tools.readthedocs.io

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Cloud-friendly, chunked and multiresolution streaming of tractograms to web viewers.

**Not for:** Apps expecting .tck or .trk input; it is a viewing and exchange format.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** output of 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.track.zarr-vectors.json

identifying_risks: Individual white matter geometry can support re-linkage as a structural fingerprint
Headers and metadata may carry subject codes or acquisition dates
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level processed neurodata without direct identifiers. Tier 4 conditions apply if used as a connectome fingerprint.
sharing_cautions: Share with coded subject IDs under a data use agreement
Strip free-text tags and dates from metadata before release
tier_conditions: Tier 1 only once aggregated across participants (e.g. a population atlas)
Tier 4 if used to build connectome fingerprints or predictive features

intended_use: Cloud-friendly, chunked and multiresolution streaming of tractograms to web viewers.
not_suitable_for: Apps expecting .tck or .trk input; it is a viewing and exchange format.

outputs_of.name: trak2zarr-vectors
outputs_of.purpose: convert a tractogram to Zarr Vectors
